type.description: Machine-readable category of the error. Versioned by `Factuarea-Version`: from `2026-09-01` onwards the payment gate codes `payment_method_required`, `seat_charge_failed`, `gestoria_plan_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required` and `employee_seat_charge_failed` are served as `payment_required_error`; requests pinned to an earlier version keep receiving `invalid_request_error` for those five. `error.code` and `error.subcode` never change — branch on `code` if you want version-independent behaviour.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. missing_api_key, insufficient_scope, parameter_invalid, invalid_status_transition. Full reference of every code grouped by bounded context: https://docs.factuarea.com/guides/errors/all.

subcode.description: Sub-code detailing the subtype within `code`. Present only on some errors, and only where `code` alone is ambiguous: on 409 duplication conflicts it pins the duplicate key (`code=resource_already_exists`, `subcode=tax_id_already_exists`), and on 402 payment errors it pins which gate rejected the call (`code=seat_charge_failed`, `subcode=seat_charge_failed`; `code=addon_required`, `subcode=webhooks_addon_required`). Like `code`, it is stable and invariant across locales and API versions.

message.example: No se ha proporcionado una API key válida en el header Authorization.
examples: No se ha proporcionado una API key válida en el header Authorization.

param.description: Field that caused the error (for parameter_invalid and similar invalid_request_error codes). On multi-field validation errors it points to the FIRST failed field; the full set lives in `errors[]`.

errors.description: Present on 422 validation errors: ALL failed fields, one item per field (not only the first). Each item carries `param`/`code`/`message` plus the optional hints `expected_format`/`allowed_values`. Additive and backward-compatible — `error.param`/`error.message` still mirror the first failed field.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for this field, derived from the failed validation rule (e.g. parameter_missing, parameter_invalid_format, parameter_invalid_enum).

message.description: Human-readable description of the field error. Localized (es/en/ca) when its `code` belongs to the stable catalog.

expected_format.description: Expected format hint (e.g. `YYYY-MM-DD`, `uuid`, `email`, `url`). Only present when the failure is a format error.

allowed_values.description: Legal values of the enum. Only present when the failure is an enum/`in` error.

details.description: Structured details about the error, present only on some errors and with a shape that depends on the case. On 409 duplication conflicts (subcodes `tax_id_already_exists`, `external_id_already_exists`, `sku_already_exists`) it carries `existing_resource_id`, the UUID of the resource that already exists. On 402 `payment_required_error` responses caused by a missing payment method it carries `payment_setup_url`, the Billing Portal link that unblocks the operation. On the 422 subcodes raised inside the domain it carries the hint of that case: `allowed_values` (rejected value outside a closed catalog), `offending_field` (field a disbursement line may not carry) or `expected` + `received` (line total checksum mismatch).

existing_resource_id.description: UUID of the pre-existing resource that triggered the conflict. Resolvable with a `GET /v1/{resource}/{id}` without an extra `find_by_*` call. Only present on 409 duplication conflicts.

payment_setup_url.description: Billing Portal URL where the payment method can be set up. Only present on 402 errors caused by a missing payment method (`payment_method_required`, `employee_seat_payment_method_required`); once the payment method is on file, retrying the same call succeeds. Absent on the other 402 codes (declined charge, plan or add-on required).

allowed_values.description: Legal values of the closed catalog the rejected value does not belong to. Present on the 422 subcodes that validate against a catalog inside the domain (`line_type_invalid`, `correction_code_illegal_for_original`). Note that a 422 raised by request validation reports the same hint per field in `error.errors[].allowed_values` instead.

offending_field.description: Name of the line field that made the operation illegal. Present on 422 `suplido_line_cannot_carry_taxes`: a disbursement line (`line_type: "SUPLIDO"`) may not carry VAT, withholding, surcharge, discount, regime key, exemption cause or product, and this names the one that was sent.

expected.description: Amount this API computed for the line. Present on 422 `line_total_checksum_mismatch`, together with `received`, so the rounding mismatch with your own ERP can be located without guessing.

received.description: Amount sent in `lines[].line_total`, which differs from `expected` by more than one cent. Present on 422 `line_total_checksum_mismatch`.

doc_url.description: Link to error reference in docs.

Event.description: A read-only record of something that happened in your account. The same object is delivered to your webhook endpoints.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the event, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`). Consistent with the `id` field of every other v1 resource.

type.description: Event type in `<category>.<action>` form (e.g. `invoice.paid`, `quote.approved`). See `GET /event-catalog` for the full list.

aggregate_id.description: UUID v7 of the resource that produced this event (e.g. the invoice for `invoice.paid`). `null` for events without backfill. Distinct from `id`, which identifies the event itself.

correlation_id.description: UUID v7 correlating this event end-to-end with the operation that produced it. `null` for events without a correlation context (e.g. born from scheduler sweeps). The key is always present.

api_version.description: API version (date-based) the payload was serialized under, sealed at emission (e.g. `2026-05-22`). `null` only for legacy events emitted before versions were sealed.

livemode.description: `true` for events generated in production (live keys, `fact_live_`); `false` for events generated in test mode (sandbox company, test keys `fact_test_`).

test.description: `true` when the event is a test delivery triggered from the dashboard; `false` for real events. Orthogonal to `livemode`, which reflects the key environment (live vs sandbox): a test delivery may be issued in either, so e.g. `livemode: true, test: true` is valid.

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of when the event was created.

Event.title: Event

EventCatalogEntry.description: A single event type available for webhook subscriptions. The full catalog is returned by `GET /v1/event-catalog`.

name.description: Event identifier (e.g. `invoice.created`, `quote.approved`).

category.description: High-level group derived from the prefix (`invoice`, `quote`, `client`, …).

description.example: Factura pagada

status.description: `available` if the event is emitted today; `coming_soon` if reserved for a future release.

EventCatalogEntry.title: EventCatalogEntry

EventData.description: The payload embedded when the event was emitted, discriminated by `type`. Carries the full snapshot of the affected resource under `object` — identical to `GET /v1/<resource>/{id}` at emission time — plus event-specific keys, e.g. `{ "type": "invoice.paid", "object": { ...invoice... }, "amount": 1210.0 }`. The snapshot is frozen: later changes to the resource do not rewrite past events.

IntegrationEvent.description: One event a payment gateway sent to Factuarea, with the outcome it produced and, when it produced none, the typed reason why. Read-only and scoped to your own company. The raw content of the event is NEVER exposed: it carries personal data of your end customers and payment details, is stored encrypted only for parked events so they can be reprocessed, and is purged 30 days after being parked.

id.description: UUID v7 of the event. Use it in `GET /v1/integrations/events/{event}` and in the replay operation.

provider.description: Gateway or integration the event came from. Closed set, so it is safe to switch on it.

event_type.description: Event type as reported by the provider, matched EXACTLY when you filter by it. Free-form text, NOT a closed enum: the field deliberately mixes the raw provider type (`charge.refunded`, `invoice.paid`) with the internal semantic value some older branches recorded (`autoinvoice.*`). Do not model it as a fixed catalogue — for a filterable, closed axis use `discard_reason`.

direction.description: Direction of the exchange: `inbound` for something the provider sent us (all gateway webhooks), `outbound` for a call the platform made to the provider, `internal` for a state change of the integration itself. Free-form string rather than an enum: it is not backed by a closed catalogue in code.

status.description: Outcome of the event: `success` (it produced its effect), `skipped` (it was discarded on purpose — see `discard_reason`) or `failure` (it broke while being processed — see `error_message`).

discard_reason.description: Typed reason why the event was discarded, from a CLOSED catalogue, or `null` when it was not discarded. This is the axis to filter and group by. A value retired from the catalogue in a later version is still returned verbatim here, but its `discard_reason_label`, `is_actionable` and `is_replayable` degrade to neutral rather than breaking the page.

discard_reason_label.description: Human-readable label of `discard_reason`, in Spanish (the platform's end-user language). `null` when there is no discard reason, or when the stored reason is no longer part of the current catalogue.

is_actionable.description: `true` when the account owner can do something about this discard (turn a setting on, re-link an account). Only actionable discards notify the user; the informative ones are recorded but never interrupt anyone.

is_replayable.description: CONTRACT of the replay operation: when it is `true`, `POST /v1/integrations/events/{event}/replay` does not answer 422. It is the conjunction of three conditions — the event is parked, it still holds its content, and its discard reason admits reprocessing — evaluated by the same handler that guards the replay. It turns to `false` on its own once the 30-day retention window purges the content, even though the event stays parked.

error_message.description: Error raised while processing the event, or `null` when there was none. Relevant for `failure`; a `skipped` event carries its reason in `discard_reason`, not here.

duration_ms.description: Server-side processing time in milliseconds, or `null` when it was not measured.

recommended_action.example: Elige una de las dos salidas, no las dos: activa la auto-facturación en la configuración de la integración y reprocesa el evento, o crea la factura a mano. Si haces ambas, el cobro acabará con dos facturas.
recommended_action.description: Next step for this specific discard reason, in Spanish and in the imperative. Present ONLY in the detail and in the 202 of the replay — the listing omits it, because repeating the same sentence across 100 elements is noise. `null` when the reason is merely informative: if there is nothing to do, the contract does not invent an instruction. The sentence tells reproducible reasons ("… y reprocesa el evento") apart from the ones that are not ("… emítela a mano"), so it never points you at a call that would answer 422. When a reason admits BOTH ways out, they are worded as mutually exclusive and the sentence spells out the consequence of doing both: replay idempotency keys on the charge and only recognises invoices issued through that same automatic path, so an invoice created by hand does not stop it — doing both leaves two invoices for one charge, each numbered in its series and filed with VeriFactu.

IntegrationEvent.title: IntegrationEvent

IntegrationEventList.description: Cursor-paginated page of integration events (`{ data, has_more, next_cursor }`), most recent first.

data.description: Page of integration events, newest first. The elements do NOT carry `recommended_action`: fetch the detail of the one you care about.

has_more.description: `true` when more events exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `starting_after` for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is `false`. Unlike the rest of the v1 listings it is a numeric string, not a UUID v7 — treat it as opaque and reuse it verbatim.

IntegrationEventList.title: IntegrationEventList

Invoice.description: A sales invoice (compliant with Spanish AEAT VeriFactu).

number.description: Definitive invoice number, or `null` for drafts (where `is_number_assigned` is `false`).

is_number_assigned.description: Whether the invoice has a definitive number assigned. `false` for drafts (where `number` is `null`); becomes `true` after `POST /v1/invoices/{uuid}/assign-real-number`, or automatically on send/payment.

type.description: AEAT invoice type code: `F1` (ordinaria), `F2` (simplificada), `F3` (sustitutiva de simplificadas), `R1`–`R5` (rectificativa).

status.description: Invoice lifecycle status.

total_disbursements.description: Sum of the `SUPLIDO` (disbursement) lines of this invoice: amounts the issuer paid in the name and on behalf of the client and re-invoices at cost. Deliberately OUTSIDE `subtotal`, `taxes_total` and `total`, because a disbursement is not part of the issuer's taxable base (art. 78.Tres.3 LIVA) and is not declared in the AEAT VeriFactu record. `0` on an invoice without disbursements.

total_to_pay.description: Amount the client actually has to pay: `total + total_disbursements`. DERIVED, never stored — one single formula computes it — and equal to `total` on an invoice without disbursements. Worked example: a 1,000.00 service line at 21% plus a 150.00 `SUPLIDO` line yields `subtotal` 1000.00, `taxes_total` 210.00, `total` 1210.00, `total_disbursements` 150.00 and `total_to_pay` 1360.00. Note that `paid_amount`/`pending_amount` are measured against `total`, not against `total_to_pay`.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

exemption_reason.description: VAT exemption cause per document (AEAT catalog E1..E6), or `null` when not exempt. Read-only: the public API derives the AEAT qualification from the regime/cause at issuance.

legal_mentions.description: Header legal mentions (includes the mention derived from the exemption cause). Read-only.

exclude_347.description: Read-only flag: whether this invoice is excluded from the annual Modelo 347 report. The public API cannot mutate it (the create/update FormRequest does not accept it); managing the flag is exclusive to the internal app.

verifactu_status.description: Status of the AEAT VeriFactu submission.

paid_amount.description: Amount already collected for this invoice (derived from the payment ledger). Satisfies the invariant `paid_amount + pending_amount === total`.

pending_amount.description: Outstanding balance pending collection for this invoice (derived from the payment ledger).

payments.description: Payment ledger summary, ALWAYS present (never `null`). `total` mirrors `paid_amount`, `pending` mirrors `pending_amount`. `detail` lists the individual payments and is materialized ONLY on the show endpoint (`GET /v1/invoices/{id}`); in list responses `detail` is `[]` (by cost) while `total`/`pending` stay populated. The detail is also available via `GET /v1/invoices/{id}/payments`.

detail.description: List of individual payments. Empty `[]` in list responses or when there are no payments yet.

is_corrective.description: Whether this invoice is a corrective (rectificativa) of another invoice.

scheduled_for.description: Scheduled emission timestamp (ISO 8601), or `null` when the invoice is not scheduled. Populated only while `status` is `scheduled`.

scheduled_action.description: Action the scheduler runs when `scheduled_for` is reached: `issue_and_send` (issue and email) or `draft` (issue only). `null` when the invoice is not scheduled.

Invoice.title: Invoice

InvoiceActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of an invoice. Groups domain events originated by changes to the invoice itself (creation, sending, payment, correction, etc.).

event_type.description: Tipo de evento de dominio (p. ej. `invoice.created`, `invoice.paid`).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: La factura se marcó como cobrada por transferencia bancaria.
examples: La factura se marcó como cobrada por transferencia bancaria.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

InvoiceActivity.title: InvoiceActivity

InvoiceCorrective.description: Correction data of a corrective invoice. Present (object) when `is_corrective=true`, `null` on ordinary invoices.

original_id.description: UUID (v7) of the original corrected invoice.

original_number.description: Human-readable number of the original corrected invoice.

original_date.description: Issue date of the original invoice (YYYY-MM-DD).

correction_reason.description: Reason for the correction (AEAT code R1–R5).

correction_nature.description: Nature of the correction (`S` substitutive / `I` by differences).

correction_aeat_type.description: AEAT corrective invoice type code (`R1`–`R5`) frozen at issuance from the VeriFactu record. `null` if not resolved.

InvoiceCorrective.title: InvoiceCorrective

InvoiceLine.description: A line item on an invoice. `line_total` is NOT part of this response: it is a write-only checksum the client may send on create/update so a rounding mismatch with its own ERP is caught (see the create/update request body).

description.example: Servicio de consultoría enero 2026

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

regime_key.description: VeriFactu special regime key (ClaveRegimen, AEAT L8.1) declared for this line, or null when the line inherits the regime from the invoice header.

exemption_reason.description: LIVA exemption cause (E1–E6) or non-subjection cause (N1/N2) declared for this line, or null when the line inherits the qualification from the invoice header.

aeat_tax_code.description: AEAT operation qualification code snapshot frozen at issuance. Read-only (derived).

line_type.description: Kind of line. `NORMAL` is an ordinary line of the issuer's own operation. `SUPLIDO` is a DISBURSEMENT: an amount the issuer paid in the name and on behalf of the client (an official fee, duty or registry charge) and now re-invoices at cost. Under art. 78.Tres.3 of the Spanish VAT Act (LIVA) a disbursement is not part of the issuer's taxable base, so a `SUPLIDO` line stays out of `subtotal`, `taxes_total` and `total`, is aggregated into `total_disbursements` instead, carries no VAT, withholding, surcharge, discount or product, and is never declared in the AEAT VeriFactu record. Always present and never `null` in a response (a line created before this field existed reads as `NORMAL`); optional on write, where it defaults to `NORMAL`.

source_invoice_reference.description: Reference of the supporting document that originated the disbursement — the receipt or fee number issued by the public body (≤100 chars). REQUIRED on a `SUPLIDO` line (a disbursement without its supporting reference is rejected with 422) and `null` on a normal line. Free text on purpose: the receipt of a public body is rarely registered as a purchase invoice.

source_invoice_ids.description: Optional traceability of a `SUPLIDO` line: IDs (UUID v7) of your own purchase invoices that back the disbursement. `null` when the line carries no traceability — never `[]`, so "no traceability" cannot be confused with "empty list". A purchase invoice of another company is rejected with 422.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed next to the quantity on the document (`hours`, `kg`, `units`, …), ≤20 chars, or `null` when not reported. Presentation only: free text with no closed catalog and no fiscal effect, since no AEAT catalog applies to the ordinary Spanish invoice.

exemption_reason_text.description: Free-text wording of the exemption provision of this line (≤255 chars), printed under the line description to satisfy the mention required by art. 6.1.j of Royal Decree 1619/2012 when the catalogued cause does not cover it. Orthogonal to `exemption_reason` and to the document-level exemption cause: no coherence is enforced between them and the automatic header legal mention is unchanged.

InvoiceLine.title: InvoiceLine

InvoicePayment.description: Datos del cobro de la factura. Presente (objeto) cuando `status` es `paid`, `null` en otro caso.

method.description: Payment method (backing value of the Shared enum `PaymentMethod`, e.g. `bank_transfer`).

InvoicePayment.title: InvoicePayment

InvoicePaymentDetail.description: A single payment recorded against an invoice (partial payment ledger entry). Listed in `payments.detail[]` (materialized only on the show endpoint) and in the standalone sub-resource `GET /v1/invoices/{id}/payments`.

id.description: Opaque UUID (v7) of the payment.

object.description: String identifying the object type. Always `payment`.

invoice_id.description: UUID (v7) of the invoice this payment belongs to.

payment_method.description: Payment method (backing value of the Shared enum `PaymentMethod`, e.g. `bank_transfer`).

payment_method_text.description: Human-readable label of the payment method (Spanish).

reference.description: Payment reference/operation number. `null` if not provided.

notes.description: Internal notes for the payment. `null` if not provided.

created_at.description: When the payment was recorded (ISO 8601), or `null`.

updated_at.description: When the payment was last updated (ISO 8601), or `null`.

InvoicePaymentDetail.title: InvoicePaymentDetail

InvoiceRecurring.description: Reference to the recurring invoice (template) that generated this invoice. `null` when the invoice does not come from a recurrence.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the parent recurring invoice.

InvoiceRecurring.title: InvoiceRecurring

InvoiceReminderPreview.description: Preview of the payment reminder email (subject + HTML + resolved recipients) without sending it. Useful to show exactly what would be sent before triggering `POST .../send-reminder`.

html.description: Rendered HTML body of the email.
html.example: <!DOCTYPE html><html lang="es"><head>...</head><body>... Recordatorio de pago. Factura F-2026-015 ... Importe total 1.802,90 € ... Fecha de vencimiento 03/05/2026 ...</body></html>
examples: <!DOCTYPE html><html lang="es"><head>...</head><body>... Recordatorio de pago. Factura F-2026-015 ... Importe total 1.802,90 € ... Fecha de vencimiento 03/05/2026 ...</body></html>

cc.description: Carbon copy addresses. Empty `[]` when there are none.

bcc.description: Blind carbon copy addresses. Empty `[]` when there are none.

status.description: Current status of the invoice (e.g. `sent`, `overdue`).

due_date.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD), or `null` if not applicable.

public_url.description: Public link to the invoice, or `null` if the link is not active.

public_link_active.description: Indicates whether the public link is active.

public_link_expires_at.description: When the public link expires (ISO 8601), or `null`.

reminders_sent.description: Number of reminders already sent for this invoice.

last_reminder_sent_at.description: When the last reminder was sent (ISO 8601), or `null` if none has been sent.

Metadata.description:
A free map of up to 50 key→value pairs for storing arbitrary structured data (values are strings up to 500 characters). Unlike `custom_fields` — an ordered list of typed `{field, value}` pairs with display semantics, present on the six document resources — `metadata` is an unordered map for opaque integration data; a document may carry both. The master resources (Client, Supplier) have no `custom_fields`, so their `metadata` doubles as the custom-fields store.

**Reserved keys (read-only).** When the system auto-issues an invoice from a payment correlation (Stripe/GoCardless/MONEI), it writes `stripe_subscription_id`, `stripe_invoice_id`, `billing_reason`, `period_start` and `period_end` into that invoice metadata automatically. Do not set or overwrite them by hand — the platform owns them and a manual value may be replaced when the correlation runs.

MonthlyRegisterSignature.description: The digital seal (signature) of a closed monthly time record register for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Sealing a `closed` period freezes a canonical SHA-256 digest of its snapshot and a detached RSA-SHA256 signature made with the company certificate, so the register is tamper-evident and independently verifiable by a third party (labour inspectorate, auditor). There is exactly one seal per close, and it is not re-sealable. The `verified`/`verification_reason` fields are recomputed live on every read against the current snapshot: reopening and re-closing the period with different data yields `verified: false` with reason `snapshot_mismatch`.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the seal, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

monthly_time_record_close_id.description: UUID v7 of the monthly close this seal belongs to.

digest.description: The canonical digest of the close snapshot at sealing time.

value.description: The snapshot digest, 64 uppercase hexadecimal characters.

signature.description: The detached digital signature of the digest.

value.description: The signature of the digest, base64-encoded.

certificate.description: The company certificate the seal was made with, kept for traceability.

serial_number.description: Serial number of the signing certificate.

subject_name.description: Subject (holder) name of the signing certificate.

thumbprint.description: SHA-256 thumbprint of the certificate, 64 hexadecimal characters.

valid_to.description: End of validity of the certificate (ISO 8601).

sealed_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who sealed the register.

verified.description: Live verification: `true` if the current snapshot and the signature are intact.

verification_reason.description: Reason of the live verification: `verified` (intact), `snapshot_mismatch` (the snapshot changed since sealing), `signature_invalid` (the signature no longer validates) or `certificate_unreadable` (the certificate could not be read).

MonthlyRegisterSignature.title: MonthlyRegisterSignature

The close can be reopened for an audited correction (state `closed ⇄ reopened`).

It is recomputed on every request, so a just-recorded clock entry is reflected without closing the month.

PaginatedList.description: Cursor-paginated list envelope shared by every v1 listing endpoint. `data` holds the page items; `has_more` signals whether another page exists; `next_cursor` is the cursor to pass back for the following page. Concrete listings narrow `data` to their resource type via `allOf`.

Series.description: A document numbering series. Immutable per AEAT compliance.

prefix.description: Legacy alias for code. Use code field. Will be removed in v2.

number_format.description: Canonical numbering mask describing how the document number is rendered: padding (the block of zeros), year token (`{YYYY}` 4 digits / `{YY}` 2 digits / omitted for no year), optional month token (`{MM}` 2 digits) and separator. Example: `{code}-{YYYY}-{000}` (default) or `{code}-{YYYY}-{00000}` for 5-digit padding. When `counter_reset` is `monthly`, the mask must include the `{MM}` token (e.g. `F-{YYYY}-{MM}-{000}`) so the rendered number stays unique across months; otherwise two months would both start at `1`. Set on creation and immutable afterwards. Mirrors Holded's `format`.

next_number.description: Next correlative that will be assigned on the next real emission.

current_number.description: Last correlative actually emitted in the current fiscal year (0 for a brand-new series).

initial_number.description: Number the counter starts from. Set on creation to continue an existing numbering when migrating (e.g. 235). Defaults to 1.

counter_reset.description: Counter reset policy (source of truth): `never` (the counter never resets), `annual` (resets on January 1st) or `monthly` (resets on the 1st of each month). `monthly` requires the `number_format` mask to include the `{MM}` token to keep rendered numbers unique across months.

year_reset.description: Deprecated alias of `counter_reset`. `true` is equivalent to `counter_reset: "annual"`, `false` to `counter_reset: "never"`. Use `counter_reset` instead; this field will be removed in v2.

composition.description: Informative breakdown of the payout reported by Stripe (component charges and fees). Component references are opaque Stripe ids (`payment_intent` = `pi_xxx`, `charge_id` = `ch_xxx`), NOT internal payment UUIDs. May be empty when the breakdown could not be read.

Tax.description: A tax rate configuration. Catalog partially global (`is_system=true` for system taxes, without `company_id`) and partially custom per company.

name.description: Human-readable name of the tax (e.g. "IVA 21%").

rate.description: Applied tax rate, e.g. `21` for 21% VAT.

applies_to.description: Scope where it applies: `sales` (sales only), `purchases` (purchases only), `both` (both).

is_default.description: true if this is the default tax for its `type` (independent of the `default_for_documents` map).

is_active.description: Indicates whether the tax is enabled for use on new documents.

is_system.description: true if the tax is from the global system catalog (not editable, without `company_id`).

examples: IVA general aplicable en territorio peninsular y Baleares.

default_for_documents.description: Map `DocumentType -> bool` indicating for which document types this tax is default. Replaces the 5 legacy booleans `is_default_invoice/quote/delivery_note/proforma/purchase_invoice`.

customer_visible_label.description: Tax label shown to the end customer on documents (PDF, public link, email).

external_reference.description: AEAT-SII / VeriFactu key (closed catalog: S1..S3 subject, E1..E6 exempt, N1..N2 not subject).

valid_from.description: Legal effective start date of the rate (BOE). Format `YYYY-MM-DD`.

valid_until.description: Legal effective end date of the rate. Invariant: `valid_until >= valid_from` when both are non-null.

country_aeat_zone.description: Zona AEAT a efectos fiscales: `peninsula` + Baleares, `canarias` (IGIC), `ceuta` (IPSI), `melilla` (IPSI).

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime DERIVED from the AEAT zone, read-only: `iva` (Península), `igic` (Canarias), `ipsi` (Ceuta/Melilla). Only set for `type=vat`; `null` otherwise.

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: Identity (UUID v7) of the linked equivalence-surcharge tax. Foreign key to the global `taxes` table (key suffix `_taxes_id` per the UUID policy). `null` when there is no link.

TaxCatalog.description: The Spanish tax catalog as a single document: indirect tax regimes with their legal rates and VeriFactu code, header-level operation regimes, exemption causes with their article and legal wording, system withholding rates, and the legal VAT/equivalence-surcharge pairs. It carries no data of the authenticated company, so two different companies receive byte-identical bodies for the same language, and it is not an entity: it has no `id` and no `object`.

primary_language.description: Language resolved from `Accept-Language` (`es`, `en` or `ca`; `es` when the header is absent or names no supported language). It declares the primary language of the document; it does not filter it — every entry always carries all three translations. It travels inside the body on purpose, which is why two languages yield different `ETag`s.

indirect_tax_regimes.description: Indirect tax regimes (IVA, IGIC, IPSI) with their legal rates, standard rate, VeriFactu L1 code and the AEAT zones that determine each one.

operation_regimes.description: Header-level operation regimes with the legal wording each one requires and whether it forces a zero VAT amount.

exemption_causes.description: Exemption, non-subjection and special-regime causes with their AEAT codes, legal wording, applicable article and whether they can be declared per line.

retention_rates.description: System withholding rates, expressed in positive. Mostly IRPF withholdings, plus one contractual retainer that is not a tax and one IRNR rate (see the entry schema). The catalog of what the platform offers, not an exhaustive list of every rate Spanish law defines.

equivalence_surcharge_pairs.description: Closed matrix of the legal VAT/equivalence-surcharge pairs of article 161 of the Spanish VAT Act.

TaxCatalog.title: TaxCatalog

TaxCatalogExemptionCause.description: An exemption, non-subjection or special-regime cause, with the AEAT code it projects to, the legal wording the invoice must carry and the article of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) it relies on. The three AEAT codes are mutually exclusive: every cause derives at most one of them, and the other two are `null`.

calificacion_operacion.description: Code of the AEAT L9 list (transaction qualification): `S2` for reverse charge, `N1`/`N2` for the two non-subjection cases. `null` when the cause is an exemption or a special regime.

causa_exencion.description: Code of the AEAT L10 list (exemption reason), `E1` to `E6`. `null` when the cause is not an exemption.

clave_regimen.description: Code of the AEAT L8A/L8B list (special regime key): `19` farming, `03` second-hand goods, `05` travel agencies, `51` equivalence surcharge, `07` cash accounting. `null` when no special regime applies.

legal_mention.example: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta conforme al artículo 25 de la Ley 37/1992.
legal_mention.description: Full legal wording (in Spanish) that the invoice must carry when this cause is declared.

article.description: Article of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) the cause relies on. `null` only for `otro`, whose wording is written by hand and has no determined article — `null` means "no article", never "not mapped".

line_level.description: `true` when the cause can be declared per invoice line (its projected code is one of `E1`-`E6`, `N1`, `N2`). `false` for the special regimes, `otro` and reverse charge, which can only be declared in the document header.

TaxCatalogExemptionCause.title: TaxCatalogExemptionCause

TaxCatalogIndirectRegime.description: An indirect tax regime determined by the territory the issuer operates from (IVA on the mainland and the Balearic Islands, IGIC in the Canary Islands, IPSI in Ceuta and Melilla). This is the "which tax applies" axis; it is orthogonal to the operation regime, which answers "how is this transaction taxed".

aeat_code.description: Code of the AEAT L1 list used by VeriFactu: `01` for IVA, `02` for IPSI, `03` for IGIC. Send this value, not the `code`, when a VeriFactu field expects the L1 list.

valid_rates.description: Every legal rate of the regime, in percentage points. Any other rate is rejected when the invoice line is created.

general_rate.description: Standard rate of the regime, the sensible default when the line has no explicit rate.

aeat_zones.description: AEAT territorial zones that determine this regime. A company whose zone is listed here charges this tax.

TaxCatalogIndirectRegime.title: TaxCatalogIndirectRegime

TaxCatalogLocalizedText.description: A catalog text in the three languages the API supports. All three are always present: the negotiated `Accept-Language` picks the primary language of the document, it never filters the payload, so a client rendering a multilingual selector does not need three requests.
TaxCatalogLocalizedText.title: TaxCatalogLocalizedText

TaxCatalogOperationRegime.description: A header-level operation regime: how a transaction is taxed regardless of which indirect tax applies. Three of the four require the invoice to be issued with no VAT amount and to carry a legal wording; sending a rate above zero on those is a fiscal error, not a formatting one.

code.description: Stable identifier of the operation regime.

legal_mention.example: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta - Art. 25 LIVA
legal_mention.description: Legal wording (in Spanish) that the invoice must carry for this regime. `null` for `general`, the ordinary domestic transaction, which requires none.

requires_zero_vat.description: `true` when the regime forces a zero VAT amount on every line of the document.

TaxCatalogOperationRegime.title: TaxCatalogOperationRegime

TaxCatalogRetentionRate.description: A system withholding rate offered by the platform. Most entries are IRPF withholdings, but not all of them, and the `IRPF_` prefix of the `code` is no proof otherwise — codes are stable identifiers, not a tax classification. Two entries are not IRPF: `IRPF_5_GARANTIA` is contractual retention money on a construction contract, with no tax nature at all (it is not reported on form 111 and nothing is paid over to AEAT), and `IRPF_24` belongs to IRNR (RDL 5/2004), the non-resident income tax. Read each `label` for the nature of its own rate instead of assuming every entry is an IRPF withholding. This block is the catalog of what Factuarea ships, NOT an exhaustive list of every rate Spanish law defines, and it never includes the custom taxes a company creates through `POST /v1/taxes`.

code.description: Stable identifier of the withholding type. It is the key, not the `rate`: two different types can share the same percentage and `applies_to` and differ only in the case they cover.

rate.description: Withholding percentage, always POSITIVE. Apply it as a deduction from the taxable base; the sign convention of the contract is positive regardless of how the rate is stored internally.

applies_to.description: `sale` for withholdings you apply on your own invoices, `purchase` for withholdings a supplier applies on theirs.

TaxCatalogRetentionRate.title: TaxCatalogRetentionRate

TaxCatalogSurchargePair.description: A legal pairing of a VAT rate with its equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia). The rates are the ones article 161 of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) fixes; article 154, which anchors the special regime, governs its content and not its rates. The matrix is closed: any other combination is rejected when the invoice line is created. It pairs a surcharge with a VAT rate, so it cannot express the 1.75% rate article 161 reserves for supplies of manufactured tobacco, which depends on the product and not on the VAT rate.

vat.description: VAT rate of the pair, in percentage points.

surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge that legally accompanies that VAT rate.

TaxCatalogSurchargePair.title: TaxCatalogSurchargePair

TaxDefaultsForDocuments.description: Defaults grouped by tax category for a given document type. Each key contains the (possibly empty) list of taxes marked as default for that `docType` within its `type`.

vat.description: Taxes with `type=vat` that are default for the requested docType.

TaxDefaultsForDocuments.title: TaxDefaultsForDocuments

TaxReport.description: A generated Spanish tax declaration (Modelo 303 quarterly VAT, or Modelo 347 yearly informational). Downloadable via `GET /v1/tax_reports/{uuid}/download`.

id.description: Opaque UUID (v7) of the generated report.

period_year.description: Fiscal year covered by the declaration (backward compat, also available in `period.year`).

period_quarter.description: Quarter (1-4) for Modelo 303; null for Modelo 347 (yearly). Backward compat, also available in `period.quarter`.

period.description: Fiscal period covered by the declaration (nested form).

format.description: Output format. `txt_aeat` is the official format accepted by the AEAT submission portal.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the generated file (audit trail).

generated_by_id.description: UUID (v7) of the user who generated the declaration (audit trail).

download_url.description: Relative download URL of the generated resource (`/v1/tax_reports/{uuid}/download`).

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings emitted during generation (e.g. invoices with incomplete data).

TaxReport.title: TaxReport

TaxReportActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a tax report generation (creation, download, etc.). The `metadata` is sanitized (internal PKs removed) before being exposed.

event_type.description: Tipo de evento de dominio (p. ej. `tax_report.generated`).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: Se generó la declaración Modelo 303 del segundo trimestre de 2026.
examples: Se generó la declaración Modelo 303 del segundo trimestre de 2026.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

TaxReportActivity.title: TaxReportActivity

TaxReportPreview.description: Preview (dry-run computation, without persisting any file) of a Modelo 303/347 for a period. Lets the integrator validate the amounts before generating the final report. Amounts are expressed in euro cents (integers).

base.description: Accumulated taxable base for that VAT rate, in cents.

cuota.description: Accumulated VAT amount for that rate, in cents.

breakdown_303.description: Breakdown by VAT rate (Modelo 303 only). Map indexed by tax rate → `{base, cuota}` in cents. Empty for Modelo 347.

totals.description: Aggregated totals of the declaration (amounts in cents).

clients_347.description: Operations with clients that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the client.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

suppliers_347.description: Operations with suppliers that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the supplier.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

invoice_count.description: Number of issued invoices considered in the period.

purchase_invoice_count.description: Number of purchase invoices considered in the period.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings detected during the computation (e.g. invoices with incomplete data).

TaxReportPreview.title: TaxReportPreview

TaxReportStats.description: Aggregated summary of the history of tax reports generated by the authenticated company: totals by type, by format, accumulated size and current fiscal period. Returned by `GET /v1/tax_reports/stats`.

TaxStats.description: Aggregated KPIs over the company tax catalog (includes global system taxes). Breakdown por `type` y por `external_reference` AEAT.

system_count.description: Taxes from the global system catalog (`is_system=true`).

by_aeat_code.description: Tax count by AEAT `external_reference`. The `"(null)"` key groups taxes without an assigned AEAT code.

TaxTotals.description: Aggregated totals of a set of lines. Returned by `POST /v1/taxes/calculate-totals`. Total formula: `subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

subtotal.description: Sum of the taxable bases of all lines (EUR).

total_vat.description: Sum of the VAT of all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of the equivalence surcharge of all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of the withholding (IRPF) of all lines.

lines.description: Calculated breakdown for each received line, in the same order.

TaxTotals.title: TaxTotals

TaxTotalsLine.description: Calculated breakdown of a single line within `POST /v1/taxes/calculate-totals`.

subtotal.description: Taxable base of the line (quantity × price − discount).

surcharge_amount.description: Equivalence surcharge amount of the line.

total.description: Total of the line (subtotal + vat + surcharge − retention).

TaxTotalsLine.title: TaxTotalsLine

TeamAbsenceCalendar.description: The monthly team absence calendar for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: for a given year and month, every active employee with their approved absences of that month (each coloured by its absence type) plus the public holidays that apply, kept separate from the absences. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by company + year/month and never exposes an `id`.

members.description: Active employees of the team, each with their approved absences overlapping the month.

absences.description: Approved absences of the employee overlapping the month.

color.description: Hex color `#RRGGBB` of the absence type, used to render it on the calendar.

status.description: Status of the absence (always `approved` on the calendar).

holidays.description: Public holidays that apply to the team during the month.

name.description: Name of the holiday.

scope.description: Scope of the holiday: national, regional (autonomous community) or local.

TeamAbsenceCalendar.title: TeamAbsenceCalendar

TeamTimeBalanceRow.description: A single row of the team time balance summary: the monthly totals of one active employee for the Control Horario (time tracking) module.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the month.

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the month.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the month.

TeamTimeBalanceSummary.description: The team time balance summary (manager view) for a month for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by company + month and holds one row per active employee with their monthly totals. Totals are in minutes.

employees.description: One row per active employee with their monthly totals.

TimeBalance.description: The time balance of an arbitrary period (`from`/`to`) of an employee for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by employee + period, so it exposes `employee_id` (UUID v7) and never an `id`. It is the same contract the monthly close reuses over closed periods. Totals are in minutes; `days` is the daily breakdown.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the balance belongs to.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the period (holidays and approved absences already discounted).

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the period.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the period.

TimeCorrection.description: A time entry correction request for the Control Horario (time tracking) module (RD-ley 8/2019). A correction is an append-only entry that references the original time entry without mutating it (analogous to a corrective invoice); its status is derived from the ledger — there is no status column. The workflow is request → approve/reject, always resolved by a manager and never self-approved.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the correction request, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

status.description: Derived workflow state: `pending` (awaiting resolution), `approved` or `rejected`.

time_entry_id.description: UUID v7 of the original time entry the correction refers to.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the corrected entry belongs to.

requested_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who requested the correction.

resolved_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who approved or rejected the request; `null` while it is still pending.

reason.description: Reason supplied with the request (or the rejection); `null` if none.
reason.example: El fichaje de salida se registró con 30 minutos de retraso.
examples: El fichaje de salida se registró con 30 minutos de retraso.

proposed.description: Map of the proposed values of the correction (shape depends on `kind`).

resolved_at.description: When the request was resolved (ISO 8601); `null` while it is still pending.

TimeCorrection.title: TimeCorrection

TimeEntry.description: A single entry of the immutable time record ledger (a clock event) for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Every clock-in, pause, resume and clock-out — live or retroactive — is an entry chained by fingerprint. The workday state is derived from these entries; there is no session table. Fingerprints are never exposed.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the time entry, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the entry belongs to.

entry_type.description: Type of clock event: `clock_in` (opens a work span), `pause_start`, `pause_end` or `clock_out` (closes the span).

occurred_at.description: When the clock event happened (ISO 8601). For retroactive entries this is the past instant supplied by the manager.

recorded_at.description: When the entry was appended to the ledger (ISO 8601).

source.description: Origin of the entry: `web` or `mobile` (live self-service) or `manual` (retroactive entry recorded by a manager).

is_retroactive.description: Whether the entry was recorded retroactively (a manual entry by a manager) rather than clocked live.

reason.description: Reason for the retroactive entry; `null` for live entries.

TimeEntry.title: TimeEntry

TimeRecordChainValidation.description: Result of recomputing and verifying the SHA-256 hash chain (`huella`) of your company time record ledger without mutating data. Returned by `GET /v1/time-entries/chain/validate`. Fingerprints are never exposed.

is_valid.description: Indicates whether the hash chain is intact.

total_records.description: Total number of time record entries considered.

first_invalid_record_id.description: UUID (v7) of the first invalid entry, or `null` if the chain is intact.

overtime_daily_threshold_minutes.description: Daily overtime threshold in minutes, or `null` to derive it from the schedule.

overtime_weekly_threshold_minutes.description: Weekly overtime threshold in minutes, or `null` to derive it from the schedule.

overtime_tolerance_minutes.description: Rounding tolerance for overtime in minutes.

clock_in_reminder_enabled.description: Whether the forgotten clock-in reminder is enabled.

clock_in_reminder_grace_minutes.description: Grace minutes after the planned start time before reminding.

line_type.description: Kind of line: `NORMAL` (default) for an ordinary line of your own operation, or `SUPLIDO` for a DISBURSEMENT — an amount you paid in the name and on behalf of the client and now re-invoice at cost, which stays out of the taxable base (art. 78.Tres.3 LIVA). Replacing the lines of a draft re-applies the same rules, so keep the field when you resend a line you read from the invoice: sending it as `NORMAL` (or omitting it) turns the disbursement into an ordinary taxable line and changes the invoice amount.

source_invoice_reference.description: Reference of the supporting document that originated the disbursement — the receipt or fee number issued by the public body (up to 100 characters). REQUIRED when `line_type` is `SUPLIDO`; leave it out on a normal line.

source_invoice_ids.description: Optional traceability of a disbursement: list of IDs (UUID v7) of your own purchase invoices that back it. A purchase invoice of another company is rejected with 422.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed next to the quantity on the document (`hours`, `kg`, `units`, …), up to 20 characters. Presentation only: free text, no closed catalog and no fiscal effect.

exemption_reason_text.description: Free-text wording of the exemption provision of this line (up to 255 characters), printed under the line description to satisfy the mention required by art. 6.1.j of Royal Decree 1619/2012 when the catalogued cause does not cover it.

line_total.description: Optional CHECKSUM of the line total. When sent, it is compared against the total this API computes and the request is rejected with 422 (`line_total_checksum_mismatch`, with the expected and received values in `error.details`) when they differ by more than one cent. Never stored and never returned.

UpdateProductRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/products/{uuid}.

Full update (PUT). All fields `sometimes`: if not sent, the
handler keeps the current value. `sku` unique scoped to the company,
ignoring the product itself. Writable: `name`, `sku`, `price`,
`description`, `tags`, `low_stock_threshold` (per-product),
`manage_stock` (document-driven stock movements flag, PATCH-style),
`currency` (EUR only — Producto is read-only EUR; any other code → 422),
`tax_rate_id`, `is_active`, `metadata`, `external_id`. `stock` is NOT
writable here (D1): stock mutation lives only in
`PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock` with its `set`/`increase`/`decrease`
semantics. Validation of `metadata` via VO `Metadata`.

manage_stock.description: Whether this product takes part in document-driven stock movements: with `true`, issuing or receiving a document that includes it moves its stock automatically and the movement is recorded in the stock ledger. It only takes effect if your company also has stock management enabled; absent or `null` means `false`.

currency.description: Product amounts are read-only EUR: only `EUR` (or absence/null) is accepted. Stock is not writable here; stock changes are made via `PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock`.

tax_rate_id.description:
`taxes` is a global system catalog (without a `company_id` column).
Do NOT use TenantRule here — it would add `WHERE company_id = X` against a
table without that column and cause a 500 (SQLSTATE 42S22). Global
validation by uuid, like in the rest of the BCs (DeliveryNote V1, etc.).

external_id.description: Third-party integration key from your ERP/CRM. Partial update: an absent value is preserved. Free-form, up to 100 characters; unique per company.

UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

UpdateProductStockRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock.

Body: `{ stock: int, operation?: 'set'|'increase'|'decrease' }`.
`operation` defaults to `set` (replace). Accepts also `add` / `subtract`
as aliases for `increase` / `decrease` for ergonomics.
UpdateProductStockRequest.title: UpdateProductStockRequest

UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/proformas/{uuid}/public-link.

`SchemaName` disambiguates the OpenAPI schema: Quote and Proforma declare
structurally identical request bodies, so without a unique name they would
collide in `components.schemas`.
UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest

UpdateProformaRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/proformas/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when
the proforma is in `draft` status (the controller maps the
transition exception to 422 `invalid_status_transition`).
UpdateProformaRequest.title: UpdateProformaRequest

external_id.description: External business key (integration key from your ERP/CRM). Partial update: an explicit `external_id: null` clears the key. Orthogonal to `external_invoice_number`.

internal_notes.description:
Extend fields. Basic SHAPE only; the `payment_method` allowlist,
`tax_period` format and `tags` cardinality are validated by the
VO/Aggregate.

custom_fields.description: Typed custom fields as `[{field, value}]`. Partial update: an explicit `custom_fields: null` empties the collection.

retention_rate.description: Per-line IRPF retention and deductible VAT. Same shape rules as create.

surcharge_rate.description: Per-line equivalence surcharge (the legal VAT↔surcharge pair is validated) and LIVA exemption reason (closed catalog).

indirect_tax_regime.description: Per-line indirect tax regime of the supplier. Same shape rule as create (defense in depth); the real invariant lives in the domain.

UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest.description: Partial update of a recurring invoice template; only the fields sent overwrite the current value, omitted ones are preserved. Writable fields mirror creation (`client_id`, `series_id`, `name`, `description`, `frequency`, `holiday_handling`, `start_on`, `end_on`, `notes`, `metadata`, `days_before_due`, `max_occurrences`, `email_to`, `send_automatically`, `lines[]`).
UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest.title: UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest

UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest.description: Update the Stripe auto-invoicing configuration. `enabled` toggles auto-invoicing; `series_id` (UUID, nullable) sets the series for auto-created invoices (`null` uses the company default); `simplified_threshold_cents` (0-300000), `require_nif`, `refunds_enabled` and `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled` are optional partial fields.
UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest.title: UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest

UpdateSupplierRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/suppliers/{uuid}.

Partial PUT update: all fields are `sometimes`. If not sent, the
handler keeps the current value. If sent as `null`, the field is
cleared (when the domain allows it).

Accepts the same fields as `CreateSupplierRequest` V1 (see docblock there).
The validation of domain invariants (XOR `tax_id`/`alternative_id`,
direct_debit ⇒ default bank account, billing_emails without duplicates,
IBAN format, metadata limits) is performed by the `Supplier` aggregate and
the VOs. The typed exceptions propagate to the `ExceptionRenderer` with the
canonical v1 envelope.

type.description: Alternative identifier type from the AEAT L7 catalog. Legacy aliases (`tax_id_foreign`/`national_id`) are accepted on input for backward compatibility.

UpdateSupplierRequest.title: UpdateSupplierRequest

customer_visible_label.description: Custom label for this tax shown to the customer on documents (e.g. "IVA 21% incluido"). Up to 200 characters.

valid_until.description: End date of the tax validity window (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Must be on or after `valid_from`.

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: FK to the linked equivalence-surcharge tax; `null` unlinks it. UUID v7 value referencing the global `taxes` catalog.

default_for_documents.description: Sets this tax as the default per document type. Object with optional booleans: `invoice`, `quote`, `delivery_note`, `proforma`, `purchase_invoice`, `recurring_invoice`.

overtime_daily_threshold_minutes.description: Daily overtime threshold in minutes (null = derive from the schedule).

overtime_weekly_threshold_minutes.description: Weekly overtime threshold in minutes (null = derive from the schedule).

clock_in_reminder_enabled.description: Whether the missed clock-in reminder is enabled.

clock_in_reminder_grace_minutes.description: Grace minutes after the scheduled time before reminding.

name.description: Weekly schedule name.

mode.description: Schedule mode: `validated` (assumed fulfilled) or `real_clocking` (computed from real clock entries).

week_pattern.description: Full weekly pattern: list of days with their time ranges.

day.description: Day of the week in ISO 8601 format (1 Monday .. 7 Sunday).

ranges.description: Time ranges for the day (empty = rest day).

end.description: Range end time (HH:MM; 24:00 is allowed as end of workday).

certificate_file.description: The digital certificate file in PKCS#12 format (`.p12` or `.pfx`).

UploadProductGalleryImageRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/products/{uuid}/gallery.

Multipart upload: `photo` or `image` (alias) field — jpeg/png/jpg/gif/webp,
max 3 MB.

We accept `image` as an alias of the canonical `photo` field for
forgiveness with integrators that send it following the more intuitive
convention. The controller normalizes it to `photo`.
UploadProductGalleryImageRequest.title: UploadProductGalleryImageRequest

UploadProductVideoRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/products/{uuid}/video.

Multipart upload: campo `video` (mp4/mov/avi/webm, max 50 MB).
UploadProductVideoRequest.title: UploadProductVideoRequest

VeriFactuActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a VeriFactu record (creation, transmission attempts, AEAT acceptance/rejection).

event_type.description: Tipo de evento de dominio (p. ej. `verifactu.record_created`, `verifactu.transmission_accepted`).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: AEAT aceptó la transmisión del registro de alta.
examples: AEAT aceptó la transmisión del registro de alta.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs), `huella` and certificate secrets are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

VeriFactuActivity.title: VeriFactuActivity

VeriFactuConfig.description: VeriFactu configuration of your company (mode, environment, enrollment). Returned by `GET /v1/verifactu/config` and `PUT /v1/verifactu/settings`. The certificate password is never exposed.

enabled.description: Indicates whether VeriFactu is enabled for the company.

auto_transmit.description: Indicates whether transmissions to AEAT are sent automatically.

is_locked_until.description: Date until which the mode change is locked, or `null` if not locked.

has_active_certificate.description: Indica si hay un certificado activo configurado.

active_certificate_id.description: UUID (v7) of the active certificate, or `null` if there is none.

VeriFactuConfig.title: VeriFactuConfig

VeriFactuEvent.description: A VeriFactu SIF event (Art. 8.1.b): a transmission/retry/AEAT-response entry of the system. The hash chain is never exposed here.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the event.

event_data.description: Non-PII descriptive data of the event (label, description, CSV, error code/message). Empty object `{}` when there is no data. Sanitized via MetadataSanitizer.

example.description: Transmisión de alta aceptada por AEAT.

examples.description: Transmisión de alta aceptada por AEAT.

status.description: AEAT status of the event.

VeriFactuEvent.title: VeriFactuEvent

VeriFactuEventSummary.description: Resumen agregado de los eventos del SIF de la empresa: total y desglose por tipo y por estado. Devuelto por `GET /v1/verifactu/events/summary`.

last_event_at.description: Date of the last event, or `null` if there is none.

VeriFactuEventSummary.title: VeriFactuEventSummary

VeriFactuRecord.description: A VeriFactu (Spanish AEAT SIF) record (alta/anulación) associated with an invoice. Includes the hash chain (`huella`), AEAT CSV and transmission status for reconciliation.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the VeriFactu record.

invoice_type.description: AEAT invoice type (F1, F2, F3, R1-R5, …).

amount.description: Total amount of the associated invoice.

status.description: Transmission status (pending, submitted, accepted, rejected, error).

huella.description: Chained SHA-256 fingerprint of the record (VeriFactu fingerprint).

aeat_submission_id.description: Submission identifier assigned by AEAT (column `aeat_submission_id`). `null` until AEAT returns it. Never the internal PK of the record.

aeat_csv.description: Secure Verification Code (Código Seguro de Verificación) returned by AEAT on acceptance. `null` until AEAT assigns it.

transmitted_at.description: ISO 8601 date of the last transmission that reached AEAT. `null` in PENDING/REJECTED/ERROR states.

is_substitute_for_simplified.description: Whether it substitutes one or more simplified invoices (F3).

VeriFactuRecord.title: VeriFactuRecord

VeriFactuStats.description: Resumen agregado de los registros VeriFactu de la empresa autenticada: conteos por estado y desglose por tipo. Devuelto por `GET /v1/verifactu/stats`.

submitted.description: Records submitted to AEAT (without a final response yet).

by_invoice_type.description: Count by AEAT invoice type (F1, F2, F3, …).

last_transmission_at.description: Date of the last transmission to AEAT, or `null` if there is none.

VeriFactuStats.title: VeriFactuStats

WeeklySchedule.description: A fixed weekly work schedule for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Defines, per weekday, the expected time ranges (from which the expected hours and the planned start time are derived). Its `mode` decides how balances are computed downstream: `validated` (the period is assumed fulfilled unless an exception) or `real_clocking` (only real clock-ins count).

id.description: Opaque identifier of the work schedule, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

name.description: Human-readable name of the schedule (e.g. `Jornada partida`).

mode.description: How the schedule computes balances: `validated` (period assumed fulfilled unless an exception) or `real_clocking` (only real clock-ins count).

week_pattern.description: Weekly pattern: one entry per configured weekday with its ordered, non-overlapping time ranges. A weekday absent from the list (or with an empty `ranges`) is a rest day.

ranges.description: Ordered, non-overlapping time ranges worked that day (empty = rest day).

weekly_hours.description: Total weekly hours derived from the sum of all time ranges in the pattern.

status.description: Lifecycle status: `active` (assignable) or `archived` (retired from use).

WeeklySchedule.title: WeeklySchedule

WorkdaySessionStatus.description: The derived state of an employee’s current workday for the Control Horario (time tracking) module, reconstructed from the open work span in the immutable ledger. There is no session table — the state is computed from the entries.

status.description: Derived workday state: `not_started`, `working`, `paused` or `finished`.

since.description: Instant of the last event of the open span (when the current state was entered), ISO 8601; `null` if the workday has not started.

last_entry_type.description: Type of the last event of the open span; `null` if the workday has not started.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `409 idempotency_key_reused`. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency).

FactuareaVersion.name: Factuarea-Version
FactuareaVersion.description: Pin the API version (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Stripe-style date versioning) for this request; omit to use the key's pinned version, or the latest if none. Unsupported version → `400 unsupported_api_version`; malformed → `400 parameter_invalid_format`. The effective version is echoed in the `Factuarea-Version` response header. See the [Versioning guide](/guides/versioning).

XActiveProfile.name: X-Active-Profile
XActiveProfile.description: Operate on behalf of a child company (gestoría master key): pass its public `id` (UUID v7) and the request runs against that child's data without changing the key's scope, tier or environment (omit to use the key's own company). Invalid UUID → `400 parameter_invalid_uuid`; unknown or non-owned id → `404 profile_not_found`. See the [Acting on behalf guide](/guides/acting-on-behalf).

time_tracking_settings_update.description: Configuración de control horario. `overtime_basis` es `weekly` o `daily`; los umbrales son minutos (opcionales; `null` = derivar del horario); el recordatorio de olvido de fichaje se configura con `clock_in_reminder_*`.

work_schedule_create.description: Alta de horario semanal. `mode` es `validated` (jornada validada) o `real_clocking` (fichaje real). `week_pattern` lista los días (`day` 1=lunes .. 7=domingo) con sus franjas `HH:MM`–`HH:MM` (lista vacía = descanso). Una franja puede ser flexible (`flexible: true` + `required_minutes`).

work_schedule_update.description: La actualización REEMPLAZA por completo el horario: `name`, `mode` y `week_pattern` son obligatorios (no hay actualización parcial del patrón).

work_schedule_assign.description: Asigna el horario a un empleado con vigencia efectivo-datada. `employee_id` (UUID v7) y `effective_from` (`Y-m-d`).

work_schedule_unassign.description: Cierra la asignación abierta del horario a un empleado. `effective_to` (`Y-m-d`) es opcional; si se omite, la fecha de hoy.

absence_type_create.description: Alta de tipo de ausencia. Todos los campos son obligatorios: `measurement_unit` (`days`/`hours`), `color` hexadecimal `#RRGGBB` y `visibility` (`everyone`/`managers_only`).

absence_type_update.description: Edición parcial: cada campo omitido conserva su valor actual.

absence_policy_create.description: Alta de política de ausencia. `allowance_type` es `limited` o `unlimited`; `allowance_days` es obligatorio solo si es `limited`. `accrual_method` es `annual` o `monthly`. `absence_type_ids` es la lista (posiblemente vacía) de UUID v7 de los tipos asociados.

absence_policy_update.description: Edición parcial: cada campo omitido conserva su valor. Si `absence_type_ids` viene, reemplaza por completo los tipos asociados.

absence_policy_assign.description: Asigna (en lote) la política a uno o varios empleados. `employee_ids` es una lista de UUID v7 con al menos un elemento.

absence_policy_unassign.description: Retira (en lote) la asignación de la política. `employee_ids` es una lista de UUID v7 con al menos un elemento.

absence_policy_carryover.description: Configura el arrastre de saldo no consumido. `carryover_type` es `none`/`capped`/`unlimited`; `carryover_max_days` es obligatorio con `capped`. El par de caducidad (`carryover_expiry_month` + `carryover_expiry_day`) es coherente: o vienen los dos o ninguno.

absence_request_create.description: Da de alta una solicitud de ausencia. En v1 `employee_id` es OBLIGATORIO (UUID v7). `absence_type_id` es el UUID v7 del tipo; el rango `start_date`/`end_date` va en `Y-m-d` con fin ≥ inicio; `note` es opcional.

absence_request_approve.description: Aprobación de una solicitud de ausencia. `note` es opcional; el aprobador no puede ser el propio solicitante.

value.note: Aprobada; saldo suficiente para el periodo solicitado.

absence_request_reject.description: Rechazo de una solicitud de ausencia. `reason` es obligatorio.

value.reason: Coincide con el cierre trimestral; por favor, solicita otras fechas.

post.description: Factuarea POSTs this body to every subscribed endpoint when a subscribed event occurs. The receiver verifies the `Factuarea-Signature` HMAC header and SHALL respond with a 2xx status to acknowledge the delivery; any other status (or a timeout) is retried with exponential backoff.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Always `application/json`.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw request body, used to verify the delivery is authentic. Format `t=<timestamp>,v1=<signature>` (and `v0=<signature>` while a rotated secret is still valid).

parameters.name: Factuarea-Event-Id
parameters.description: Stable identifier of the event (UUID v7). Identical across redeliveries of the same event.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Event-Type
parameters.description: Type of the delivered event, e.g. `invoice.paid`.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Delivery-Id
parameters.description: Identifier of this specific delivery attempt (UUID v7). Differs on each redelivery of the same event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Standard idempotency header. Its value is identical to `Factuarea-Event-Id` (the stable UUID v7 of the event), so a receiver can deduplicate redeliveries using the industry-standard header.

200.description: The receiver acknowledged the delivery. Any 2xx status is treated as success; the body is ignored.

4XX.description: The receiver rejected the delivery. Factuarea retries with exponential backoff until the endpoint is disabled.

5XX.description: The receiver failed to process the delivery. Factuarea retries with exponential backoff.
